verdict.rationale: Skills package repeatable workflows ("automating personal tasks") that Claude can load on its own when relevant, and the surrounding Claude Code tooling offers background sessions (agent view), headless `claude -p` runs, plugins bundling hooks, and the Agent SDK for programmatic runs. However, nothing documents a skill itself being scheduled or triggered to run unattended in the background, and community reports say automatic skill invocation is unreliable (in one cited eval the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases). Missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger-based background execution of skills, documentation tying skills to unattended automation, and reliable autonomous invocation.
